mapper.select: SELECT AS time_bucket, r.channel_id, MAX(c.channel_name) AS channel_name, r.monitor_id, MAX(m.monitor_name) AS monitor_name, r.advertiser_id, MAX(a.advertiser_name) AS advertiser_name, r.app_link_id, MAX(l.link_name) AS app_link_name, COALESCE(MAX(d.ratio), 1.0000) AS deduction_ratio, SUM(r.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(r.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(r.eligible_click_count) AS eligible_click_count, SUM(r.deduplicated_click_count) AS deduplicated_click_count, SUM(r.skipped_click_count) AS skipped_click_count, SUM(r.classified_click_count) AS classified_click_count, CASE WHEN SUM(r.impressions) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.clicks) * 100.0 / SUM(r.impressions), 4) END AS click_rate, SUM(r.cost_amount) AS cost_amount, SUM(r.revenue_amount) AS revenue_amount, SUM(r.activate_count) AS activate_count, CASE WHEN SUM(r.classified_click_count) != SUM(r.clicks) OR SUM(r.eligible_click_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.activate_count) * 100.0 / SUM(r.eligible_click_count), 4) END AS activate_rate, SUM(r.first_activate_count) AS first_activate_count, CASE WHEN SUM(r.classified_click_count) != SUM(r.clicks) OR SUM(r.eligible_click_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.first_activate_count) * 100.0 / SUM(r.eligible_click_count), 4) END AS first_activate_rate, SUM(r.evoke_count) AS evoke_count, SUM(r.reactivation_count) AS reactivation_count, CASE WHEN SUM(r.classified_click_count) != SUM(r.clicks) OR SUM(r.eligible_click_count) = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM(r.reactivation_count) * 100.0 / SUM(r.eligible_click_count), 4) END AS reactivation_rate, SUM(r.login_count) AS login_count, SUM(r.register_count) AS register_count, SUM(r.payment_count) AS payment_count, SUM(r.acquisition_count) AS acquisition_count, SUM(r.next_stay_count) AS next_stay_count, SUM(r.retention_3d_count) AS retention_3d_count, SUM(r.retention_4d_count) AS retention_4d_count, SUM(r.retention_5d_count) AS retention_5d_count, SUM(r.retention_6d_count) AS retention_6d_count, SUM(r.retention_7d_count) AS retention_7d_count, SUM(r.visit_count) AS visit_count, SUM(r.authentication_count) AS authentication_count, SUM(r.order_count) AS order_count, SUM(r.first_order_count) AS first_order_count, SUM(r.finish_order_count) AS finish_order_count, SUM(r.raw_conversion_count) AS raw_conversion_count, SUM(r.forwarded_conversion_count) AS forwarded_conversion_count, SUM(r.deducted_conversion_count) AS deducted_conversion_count, SUM(r.delivery_failure_count) AS delivery_failure_count FROM scx_adx_hourly_report r LEFT JOIN scx_adx_channel c ON c.id = r.channel_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_monitor_link m ON m.id = r.monitor_id AND m.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_advertiser a ON a.id = r.advertiser_id AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_app_link l ON l.id = r.app_link_id AND l.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN scx_adx_deduction_rule d ON d.channel_id = r.channel_id AND d.app_link_id = r.app_link_id AND d.deleted = 0 WHERE r.time_hour >= #{start} AND r.time_hour < #{end} AND r.channel_id = #{channelId} AND r.monitor_id = #{monitorId} AND r.advertiser_id = #{advertiserId} AND r.app_link_id = #{appLinkId} GROUP BY , r.channel_id, r.monitor_id, r.advertiser_id, r.app_link_id ORDER BY DESC, MAX(c.channel_name), MAX(a.advertiser_name)

SELECT DATE(r.time_hour) AS report_date, SUM(r.impressions) AS impressions, SUM(r.clicks) AS clicks, SUM(r.eligible_click_count) AS eligible_clicks, SUM(r.deduplicated_click_count) AS deduplicated_clicks, SUM(r.skipped_click_count) AS skipped_clicks, SUM(r.classified_click_count) AS classified_clicks, SUM(r.cost_amount) AS cost_amount, SUM(r.activate_count) AS activates, SUM(r.first_activate_count) AS first_activations, SUM(r.reactivation_count) AS reactivations, SUM(r.register_count) AS registrations, SUM(r.payment_count) AS payments, SUM(r.next_stay_count) AS retention_d2, SUM(r.retention_3d_count) AS retention_d3, SUM(r.retention_4d_count) AS retention_d4, SUM(r.retention_5d_count) AS retention_d5, SUM(r.retention_6d_count) AS retention_d6, SUM(r.retention_7d_count) AS retention_d7, SUM(r.raw_conversion_count) AS raw_conversions, SUM(r.forwarded_conversion_count) AS forwarded_conversions, SUM(r.deducted_conversion_count) AS deducted_conversions, SUM(r.delivery_failure_count) AS delivery_failures, MAX(r.update_time) AS data_updated_at FROM scx_adx_hourly_report r WHERE r.time_hour >= #{start} AND r.time_hour < #{end} AND r.channel_id = #{channelId} AND r.advertiser_id = #{advertiserId} AND r.app_link_id = #{appLinkId} AND r.monitor_id = #{monitorId} GROUP BY DATE(r.time_hour) ORDER BY report_date

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.status='ACTIVE' THEN c.id END) AS active_channels, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.status='ACTIVE' THEN a.id END) AS active_advertisers, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS active_app_links, SUM(m.route_status='PUBLISHED') AS published_routes, SUM(m.route_status='DRAFT') AS draft_routes, SUM(m.route_status NOT IN ('PUBLISHED','DRAFT')) AS abnormal_routes FROM scx_adx_monitor_link m JOIN scx_adx_channel c ON c.id=m.channel_id AND c.deleted=0 JOIN scx_adx_advertiser a ON a.id=m.advertiser_id AND a.deleted=0 JOIN scx_adx_app_link l ON l.id=m.app_link_id AND l.deleted=0 WHERE m.deleted=0 AND m.channel_id = #{channelId} AND m.advertiser_id = #{advertiserId} AND m.app_link_id = #{appLinkId} AND m.id = #{monitorId}
